adapter_rules: derive inventory_items.stock_location_id from tenant/legacy branch SO3 location mapping on legacy INSERT
derive inventory_movements.stock_location_id from the referenced inventory item on legacy INSERT
derive occurred_at from legacy created_at/now when absent
derive deterministic reason_code from legacy movement_type when absent
derive source_reference from legacy reference_id/id when absent
do not alter quantity_delta, movement_type, legacy reference identity, stock cache semantics, or exact-once reservation/finalization behavior
fail closed when an SO3 stock-location mapping cannot be resolved
